Hi all — quick legal read below (high level). I reviewed the attached OrderForm redlines. Summary of proposed legal changes and information requests: 

1) Pricing language: we will accept the minimum-commit amount as listed but need to replace the phrase "per seat" with "per billing unit (tokens or seats as specified in Appendix A)" to avoid ambiguity on overages. Please confirm which measurement RailMesh expects in Appendix A. Suggested redline: 
  - Replace: "per seat"
  - With: "per billing unit as defined in Appendix A (token-based by default unless seat-based is selected and initialed by both parties)"

2) Net terms: Redwood standard is Net45 for enterprise pilots, but we can accept Net30 conditioned on receipt of a PO and an executed Order Form. If RailMesh wants Net30 without PO, we need an irrevocable prepayment for the activation fee.

3) Taxes and withholding: propose clause to require the customer to remit any required withholding taxes and provide evidence within 30 days of request. If Gross-Up is requested, RailMesh should include the gross-up calculation in the PO. Suggested redline language provided in the attached snippet.

4) Invoicing cadence: legal will accept activation invoiced at signing and monthly thereafter so long as the payment trigger and service commencement date are explicitly aligned in Section 2.4. We'll insert a short clause about pro rata calculation for partial months.

Action items for RailMesh (Samantha): please provide the preferred billing metric for Appendix A, the PO timeline, and a tax certificate (W-9/W-8). For Redwood: Diego to confirm measurement and Karthik to confirm whether Net30 can be accommodated upon receipt of PO.

I'll prepare a tracked-change Order Form with the above changes and circulate by EOD 5/27.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

Hi team — finance check on the points below: 

- Net terms: we prefer Net45 for pilots. However, we will accept Net30 if RailMesh provides a PO and the activation invoice is paid upfront or covered by a prepayment arrangement. If AP will only accept Net30 and cannot prepay, Redwood can agree to Net30 but will apply a 1.25% processing fee on monthly invoices for customers without prepayment.

- Invoicing cadence: activation invoice at signing (full activation amount) + monthly invoices on the 1st of the month for consumption. For early/partial month start we will prorate. We can also invoice monthly in arrears with a 7-day grace for disputed items.

- Tax evidence: RailMesh should provide a tax certificate (W-9 / W-8) and confirm entity name and tax ID to ensure invoices are issued to the correct legal entity. For cross-border withholding scenarios, we will follow the law: customer is responsible for withholding and must provide evidence; Redwood will work with AP to provide invoice-level tax fields.

I'll coordinate with billing to prepare two invoice templates (Net30 + Net45) so AP can see the final PDF before issuing PO. Diego — can you ask Samantha to share the vendor entity and PO sample?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
